kinds.name: Scroll-driven reveal / parallax

primary_engines.name: GSAP ScrollTrigger
primary_engines.when: non-trivial pin/scrub/sequencing, or Firefox support required

primary_engines.name: Lenis
primary_engines.when: paired with GSAP for smooth scroll; do not combine with native smooth scroll

kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: kill pin:true/scrub:true triggers, ScrollTrigger.normalizeScroll(false), render in normal document flow

kinds.name: 3D scene / WebGL / WebGPU

primary_engines.name: Three.js r185+ / React Three Fiber
primary_engines.when: React team, needs WebGPU baseline with WebGL fallback

primary_engines.name: <model-viewer>
primary_engines.when: one-tag GLB+AR embed, no custom scene logic needed

kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: frameloop='demand', OrbitControls autoRotate=false, static camera view, poster image remains LCP

kinds.name: Shader / GLSL fragment

primary_engines.name: glslCanvas
primary_engines.when: one script tag, no build step

kinds.min_viable_condition: team has GLSL authoring capacity AND compile time < 200ms on mid-tier Android
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: replace canvas with static gradient div; do not run RAF without rendering

kinds.name: Cursor / pointer-tracking

primary_engines.name: Motion useMotionValue
primary_engines.when: React, spring-physics preferred, already using Motion elsewhere

kinds.min_viable_condition: audience is desktop-first B2B/SaaS/portfolio, NOT form-heavy or mobile-first
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: no pointermove handler at all; static layout; browser cursor never hidden

kinds.name: Animated illustration (Lottie/dotLottie/Rive)

primary_engines.name: dotLottie-web
primary_engines.when: stateless loop, smallest bundle, new asset

primary_engines.name: Rive runtime
primary_engines.when: multi-state UI (idle->hover->pressed) driven by user input

kinds.min_viable_condition: illustration replaces a paragraph of explanation, not decoration

kinds.name: Preloader / intro sequence

primary_engines.name: GSAP timeline on window.load
primary_engines.when: heavy hero assets that genuinely take >1s

kinds.min_viable_condition: real asset load time > 1s AND brand intro is part of the product story; default is NO preloader
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: skip fade, dismiss synchronously on window.load

kinds.name: Page transitions (SPA)
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: browser auto-snaps to instant crossfade; explicit CSS override optional

kinds.name: Generative art / canvas
kinds.min_viable_condition: site benefits from ambient movement but does not have a 3D asset
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: noLoop() after one draw, or unmount canvas for static img

kinds.name: Audio-reactive
kinds.min_viable_condition: has_audio_input == true AND explicit user-gesture gate implemented
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: static equalizer bars, no RAF-driven animation

kinds.name: AR / <model-viewer>

primary_engines.name: <model-viewer>
primary_engines.when: GLB + AR on iOS in one tag; requires explicit human opt-in per R11_ar_gate (not auto-selected by router)

kinds.min_viable_condition: explicit_user_request_for_ar_quicklook == true (manual opt-in only, mirrors R12 for kind-xii); also requires product is physical AND glTF/USDZ asset <= 5MB exists
kinds.acceptance_test_ref: tests/kind-xi.spec.ts (no starter demo — opt-in only; agent must add component + spec when user explicitly requests AR)

kinds.name: AI-generated live motion
kinds.min_viable_condition: explicit user opt-in per request; never default-included by the router
kinds.reduced_motion_behavior: apply generated palette with 0ms transition; Cancel still works
